description.p: Lectern opens a Markdown file and shows it, the way a document viewer shows a PDF. There is no editing interface and no sidebar: open a file, read it, search it, print it.
Documents are rendered with native GTK widgets rather than an embedded browser engine, so the app starts instantly and the text behaves like text everywhere else in the desktop.

ul.li: CommonMark and GitHub-Flavored Markdown: tables, task lists, footnotes and strikethrough
Fenced code blocks with syntax highlighting
Find, with whole-word and case-sensitive options, that searches table cells too
Automatic reload when the file changes on disk, keeping your place

description.p: Images hosted on the web are not fetched when a document is opened. Opening a file should not tell whoever hosts its images that you opened it, so remote images load only when you ask for them.

Find matches text inside table cells as well as body text
